description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, adding {B}.
When Mnemonic Wall dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
